_rule: Card h3 substring -> lane directory (string), or {lane, allow, note}. ledger_claims.py re-derives every number a mapped card states from that lane's evidence files (RESULTS.md, results*, PREREG*, README, replies/, comment/, code/); a percentage also matches its fraction form. 'allow' lists derived values that do not appear literally - each one's derivation goes in 'note' and was verified by hand once. Unmapped cards are reported, not skipped silently.
